Home / Our Delivery Process

From requirement to delivery.

The steps ENGISOFT follows to deploy BIM professionals and to deliver BIM packages, with what happens at each step and who is involved.

Speed to deploy

From request to a working BIM professional.

Request to start: typically 3–9 days

  1. Day 0

    Share your requirement

    Role, software, sector, onsite or remote.

  2. 1–3 days

    Receive a verified shortlist

    Assessed profiles with competency passports.

  3. 1–3 days

    Interview & select

    You meet the shortlist and choose.

  4. 1–3 days

    Onboard & mobilise

    Set up in your standards, onsite or remote.

  5. Ongoing

    Performance check-ins

    Regular reviews and continuity cover.

BIM services

Delivering packages.

01

Scope and inputs

Drawings, models, LOD and deliverables agreed; missing information raised as queries.

02

Set-up

Templates, coordinates, naming and checklists configured from your BEP.

03

Modelling

Discipline models built and reviewed internally at agreed milestones.

04

Coordination

Clash runs and resolution with your team in each coordination cycle.

05

QA and issue

Models and drawings checked against the checklist, then issued with a record.
